verdict.rationale: Qdrant's hybrid-queries docs explicitly support combining dense and sparse vectors for semantic plus exact word matching. They also document built-in fusion methods (`rrf` and `dbsf`) for merging results from different queries, and the docs confirm sparse embeddings can be configured alongside dense ones. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of BM25-specific sparse scoring or keyword-index integration, a documented single-request query example, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid fusion quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote: Qdrant has a few ways of fusing the results from different queries: `rrf` and `dbsf`
in text search, it is often useful to combine dense and sparse vectors to get the best of both worlds: semantic understanding from dense vectors and precise word matching from sparse vectors
Configure dense, sparse, and multi-vector embeddings.
